meta.time: hours from the start (t = 0 is a Monday, 00:00); day = t / 24

outcomes.FAILED: did not produce its output for a reason outside the inputs (equipment, chance); may be retried; the node gets no data point
outcomes.ABANDONED: did not produce a usable output because of its inputs (a cold melt that drips, a cracked or porous part); a viability label 0 at that node's inputs
outcomes.EARLY_STOPPED: a usable part the policy chose not to take further (partial evaluation); upstream data kept
outcomes.STALE: proposed but never run (refused for budget, or still queued at the horizon)
outcomes.NOT_AS_PLANNED: ran, but what was made differs from the design (e.g. Mg boiled off); fit on the executed values
outcomes.DOWN: a station breakdown; bookings wait for the repair, none fail
